tytul: Grilled asparagus in olive oil with garlic: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for grilled asparagus kept in olive oil with garlic.

ostrzezenia.tekst: There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors.
Appearance, smell and taste cannot tell you whether vegetables in oil carry a botulism hazard.

The acidification method for homemade garlic and herb oils was developed only for garlic, basil, oregano and rosemary; it does not cover other vegetables or herbs, such as peppers or mushrooms. Adding garlic does not bring asparagus under this method.

According to ANSES, the French food safety agency, the foods that most often cause botulism include canned vegetables, such as peppers, asparagus, Greek-style olives and tapenade, and canned meat, such as terrine and pâté, usually homemade or artisanal.

akapity: Peppers, garlic, mushrooms and eggplant have been involved in botulism outbreaks from vegetables and herbs in oil, mostly homemade products.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for asparagus in oil from a checked source.
